Medicus Suite — Companion HUD test build (v3.240.3)
===================================================

Download medicus-suite-companion-test.zip and Load unpacked.

Companion now has a dedicated Minimise / Restore button on the title
row. Minimised, it shrinks to a compact bar and still shows the due
count. The choice persists across page changes.

SHA-256 is in SHA256SUMS.txt. Drop dist/ before merge.
